info.description:
# Authentication

Authentication uses standard REST authentication via Bearer token

# Error Codes

HTTP status codes give result.

200 OK

201 Created

202 Accepted

204 No Content

400 Bad Request

401 Unauthorized

403 Forbidden

404 Not Found

405 Method Not Allowed

429 Too Many Requests

500 Internal Server Error

503 Unavailable
